title: Calibrating the Heston model with deep differential networks
abstract: arXiv:2407.15536v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We propose a gradient-based deep learning framework to calibrate the Heston option pricing model (Heston, 1993). Our neural network, henceforth deep differential network (DDN), learns both the Heston pricing formula for plain-vanilla options and the partial derivatives with respect to the model parameters. The price sensitivities estimated by the DDN are not subject to the numerical issues that can be encountered in computing the gradient of the Heston pricing function. Thus, our network is an excellent pricing engine for fast gradient-based calibrations. Extensive tests on selected equity markets show that the DDN significantly outperforms non-differential feedforward neural networks in terms of calibration accuracy. In addition, it dramatically reduces the computational time with respect to global optimizers that do not use gradient information.

translated_title: 基于深度微分网络的Heston模型校准
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一种基于梯度的深度学习框架来校准Heston期权定价模型（Heston, 1993）。我们的神经网络（以下简称深度微分网络，DDN）同时学习普通香草期权的Heston定价公式以及关于模型参数的偏导数。DDN所估计的价格敏感度不会遭遇在计算Heston定价函数梯度时可能出现的数值问题。因此，我们的网络是一个优秀的价格引擎，可用于快速的基于梯度的校准。在选定股票市场开展的大量测试表明，DDN在校准精度方面显著优于非微分前馈神经网络。此外，与不使用梯度信息的全局优化器相比，它大幅减少了计算时间。
tldr: 本文提出深度微分网络（DDN），同时学习Heston定价公式及其参数偏导数，从而实现快速准确的基于梯度的期权定价模型校准，在校准精度和计算速度上均显著优于现有方法。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a deep differential network (DDN) that learns both the Heston pricing formula and its parameter derivatives, enabling fast and accurate gradient-based calibration that significantly outperforms non-differential neural networks in accuracy and global optimizers in computational speed.
